summary: The §7.2 enrichment backfill that atproto-sync's best-effort enqueue relies on as its safety net has no production caller
evidence: jobs.ts:228 justifies swallowing enqueue failures with "§7.2's backfill will find anything this misses". claimBatch (load.ts:688) and claimLlmBatch (load.ts:772) are exported but a repo-wide grep for both names outside load.ts finds only load.db.test.ts and a comment in schema.test.ts — no job, no CLI, no cron. recipe-enrichment/index.ts registers only ENRICH_JOB and LLM_ENRICH_JOB.

summary: PostHog Prompt Management: the 'production' label on recipe-llm-enrichment points at version 1, while latest is version 3 — a deploy would serve v1 to the llm-enrich step
evidence: prompt-fetch.ts:87 fetches with label:'production'. llma-prompt-list reports all_labels: production->1, latest_version: 3. v1 predates the {{allergen_slugs}}/{{diet_slugs}}/{{cuisine_slugs}}/{{meal_type_slugs}}/{{spice_level_slugs}} variables (it hardcodes the five slug lists inline, so compilePrompt substitutes nothing and the prompt can drift from the enum schema.ts enforces) AND predates the 'user will never see the rule you override' caution entirely. v3 has the variables but still carries the stale counter-example suffix 'Cannot confirm which is used — replaces rules verdict "unknown"' that commit 626141e removed from FALLBACK_PROMPT. Net: neither published version matches the code fallback; a v4 is needed and the production label must move to it before the LLM flag is ratcheted off 0%.

summary: pipeline-worker crash-loops in production: loadConfig's Bull Board password guard is role-blind, so the worker rejects itself over a UI it never serves
evidence: config.ts:56 threw when NODE_ENV=production and PIPELINE_AUTH_PASSWORD was unset. Both entrypoints call loadConfig() (server.ts:49, worker.ts:26), but only server.ts serves the board. .railway/railway.ts:334 sets NODE_ENV=production on pipeline-worker and deliberately does NOT set PIPELINE_AUTH_PASSWORD — it is declared only on the pipeline service (line 207, generator secret(44)). Every worker replica therefore died at boot and no queue was drained. Reported from a live production deploy after #39+#43 merged to main.

evidence: railway deployment 11eeff57 (buttery @ 197f0cc) FAILED: '[error] corrupted migrations: previously executed migration 1787772317269_comment_recipe_enrichment_sparse_labels is missing' from 'pnpm --filter @buttery/web db:migrate:up'
